title: Number of Connected Components In An Undirected Graph
prompt: You have a graph of n nodes. You are given an integer n and an array edges where edges[i] = [ai, bi] indicates that there is an edge between ai and bi. Return the number of connected components of the graph.
hints: Union-Find: start with n components. For each edge, union the two nodes. Decrement count when we merge two different components.
Or DFS/BFS: count number of times we need to start a traversal to visit all nodes.
Build adjacency list, iterate nodes, if unvisited run DFS and increment count.
